model: 1000 four-arm stars, N=10, rho_poly=0.8, rho=0.85, T=1, dt=0.01

tau_int_descriptive.definition: integral of G through the resolved diagnostic region divided by the full G(0); dominated by the short-time modulus and not a useful long-tail terminal time

fixed_cutoff_duration_rule.status: empirical planning rule for this system and estimator, not universal

diffusion.wording: stable long-time diffusion coefficient with motion approaching/consistent with the Fickian regime; not a claim of a perfectly asymptotic alpha=1 plateau
